question: A part of the sum of ₹31,000 was lent at 9% per annum simple interest and the remaining at 7% per annum simple interest for a period of 2 years. If the total interest earned was ₹4,820, what was the sum lent at 9%?
solution:
**Given:**

A part of the sum of ₹31,000 was lent at 9% per annum simple interest and the remaining at 7% per annum simple interest for a period of 2 years. Total interest earned was ₹4,820.

**Formula used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = P × R × T / 100

**Calculations:**

Let the sum lent at 9% be ₹x.

Then, the sum lent at 7% will be ₹(31,000 - x).

Total interest = Interest from 9% + Interest from 7%

4820 = x × 9 × 2 / 100 + (31000 - x) × 7 × 2 / 100

⇒ 4820 = 18x / 100 + 4340 - 14x / 100

⇒ 4820 = (18x - 14x) / 100 + 4340

⇒ 4820 = 4x / 100 + 4340

⇒ 480 = 4x / 100</p&g
t;

⇒ 48000 = 4x

⇒ x = 12000

**∴ The correct answer is option (1).**
